result.description:
On behalf of our client Gulf Hydraulic, we are seeking a qualified Fitter General, fitter and turners /Machinists for a full-time position in Malaga. Gulf Hydraulics Australia is a leader in the Hydraulics Industry for the service and repair of Hydraulic Pumps, Motors and Cylinders and has been recognised as service provider for the offshore, industrial and mining sectors.

Primary responsibilities Fitters and Turners
 
- Assembled and fitted precision hydraulic cylinder components, including barrels, rods, pistons, glands, and specialized seal kits, to full operational compliance.
- Operated workshop machinery and heavy press equipment to accurately install interference-fit bushes and components.
- Conducted diagnostic pressure testing, including bypass and static pressure leak testing, to verify fluid power integrity and safety standards.
- Utilized precision hand tools and torque equipment to tighten fasteners and sub-assemblies to exact OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specifications.
- Maintained quality control records, documented test data, and assigned unique job identifiers/ID tracking to completed units prior to final surface finishing (coating/spraying).
- Setting up and operating conventional lathes and milling machines to turn, face, thread, or bore metal stock.
- Machining new or worn parts (like reclaiming a worn cylinder rod or machining a new gland/piston from scratch) to exact tolerances.
- Using engineering drawings and precision measuring tools (micrometers, vernier calipers) to machine components down to the millimeter.

Primary responsibilities Machinist
•     Operate machine tools such as lathes, milling machines,
•     Manufacture rods, glands, pistons, barrels, bases, fittings, bushes
•     Review specifications for a job.
•     Calculate where to cut or bore.
•     Shape steel, aluminum, other materials.
•     Determine how fast or slow workpiece is fed into machine.
•     Determine how much material to remove.
•     Select tools and materials for the job.
•     Plan the sequence of cutting and finishing operations.
•     Mark the workpiece to show where cuts should be made.
•     Position workpiece on the lathe or milling machine.
•     Monitor and control feed rate and speed.
•     Ensure workpiece is properly lubricated and/or cooled.
•     Regulate temperature of workpiece.
•     Detect problems by listening for specific sounds.
•     Adjust cutting speed to compensate for harmonic vibrations.
•     Monitor the accuracy of cuts.
•     Replace dull cutting tools.
•     Check accuracy of work against specifications.
•     Ability to use precision tools (eg. Micrometers internal & external)
•     Use manual machinery.

Qualifications/Knowledge/Skills/Experience
 
•     Adequate work experience or Certificate Ill in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Fitter & Machinist)
•     Good mechanical aptitude.
•     Excellent reading comprehension
•     Physical Stamina


The salary range is from $79,500 to $85,000 per year plus super.

Dunsteel Engineering Pty Ltd is a leading steel fabrication business with over 50 years of experience. We specialise in delivering complex projects for leading building firms and architects. Dunsteel are at the forefront of prefabricated stairway design for large multistorey buildings. We are currently seeking to fill the position of Boilermaker who will be responsible for:

Main task:
Complete work involving structural steel
Complete tasks involving welding out
Study blueprints to determine locations, relationships, and dimensions of parts
Locate and mark reference points for columns or plates, following blueprints and using straightedges, squares, transits, and measuring instruments.
Lay out plate, sheet steel, or other heavy metal, and locate and mark bending and cutting lines, using protractors, compasses, and drawing instruments or templates
Shape and fabricate parts, using heavy-metalworking machines such as brakes, rolls, and drill presses
Maintain a safety focus with a high attention to detail to abide by site safety processes
Join metal sections and structures together using welding, bolting or riveting methods
Perform assigned duties in a timely and safe manner
General boiler making duties including use of: grinding, cutting, welding, polishing, cropping, pressing, heat treatment and stress relieving of steels.
Co-ordinate and work in a team environment.
Ensure the work is performed as per Job Cards or ITP's and current schedule of works.
Daily time cards are completed accurately and on time.
Assist in the management of a harmonious environment, team building and training of apprentices and other employees as required.
Adherence to company procedures.

Trade qualified
Professional approach

Excellent attention to detail

Employer: General Transport Equipment Pty Ltd
Position: Fitter
Employment Type: Full-Time Permanent
Location: Kewdale, WA 6105
Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

GENERAL TRANSPORT EQUIPMENT PTY LTD is currently seeking an experienced Fitter to join our growing team in Kewdale, WA 6105. Due to continued business growth, we are looking for a motivated and reliable tradesperson to support the assembly, fitting, installation, repair, and maintenance of transport equipment, mechanical components, and related systems.

This is a full-time permanent position offering an annual salary of $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience.

Key Responsibilities
Read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and workshop documentation.
Assemble, fit, install, and modify mechanical components, transport equipment, and related systems.
Perform mechanical fitting, repairs, adjustments, and maintenance activities on trailers, semi-trailers, and associated equipment.
Inspect, test, and measure completed work to ensure accuracy, quality, and compliance with required standards.
Diagnose mechanical faults and carry out repairs, servicing, and preventative maintenance.
Use hand tools, power tools, and specialised equipment to complete fitting and mechanical tasks.
Ensure all work is completed in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements and quality procedures.
Maintain a safe, clean, and organised workshop environment.
About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

A relevant trade qualification as a Fitter, Mechanical Fitter, or equivalent.
A minimum of 1–2 years of relevant experience as a Fitter or in a similar mechanical fitting role.
Experience working with mechanical components, equipment assembly, repairs, and maintenance.
Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
The ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
A strong commitment to quality workmanship and workplace safety.

What We Offer
Full-time permanent employment.
Annual salary of $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation.
A supportive and professional working environment.
Opportunity to work with specialised transport equipment and mechanical systems.
Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
Monthly staff lunches and additional employee benefits.

If you are an experienced Fitter looking to join a well-established and growing company, we encourage you to apply.
